privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data {bdeName} collects about its members, why, and how to exercise your rights. This text is generic and should be adapted by your organization if needed.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
dataCollected.description: When you sign in via 42, we receive and store:
dataCollected.note: This information is resynced from the 42 API on every sign-in.

purpose.title: Why we collect it
purpose.description: It's used solely to manage access and activity within the organization: identifying members, managing roles and permissions, and keeping an audit trail of sensitive actions.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.description: Your data is kept for as long as you're a member. When an administrator removes you, your account is deleted; some historical records (like the audit log) keep your login as plain text, with no link to an account, for accountability. Events you created or were in charge of keep your login as plain text (when the Events module is enabled).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.description: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data from an administrator or owner at any time. You can also export a copy of your own data yourself below.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Only technical cookies are used, none for tracking or analytics: the session cookie (up to 30 days), which keeps you signed in; short security cookies set while you sign in with 42; and a cookie that remembers your language. Your theme choice (light or dark) is kept in the browser, without a cookie.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: For any question, contact an administrator or owner of {bdeName}.
contact.withAddress: For any question or to exercise your rights, write to

export.title: Export my data
export.description: Download a copy of everything we hold about you, as JSON.

notifications.title: Emails and notifications
notifications.description: Your email address is also used to write to you: if your club has turned on email, you may receive one when your access is approved, when an event is confirmed, or the day before an event you are in charge of. Owners and the members who can approve access receive new requests. Messages may also be posted in the club's Discord or Slack channel: they mention the name and login of the people concerned (new request, member approved or removed).

calendar.title: Personal calendar link
calendar.description: If the Events module is turned on, a personal subscription link (a random code) is created for your calendar. Anyone who has this link can read the events you are allowed to see: do not share it. You can replace it at any time from "My profile"; it stops working if your account is deleted.

sharedCalendar.subtitle: A single link for the whole BDE, to paste once into the board's shared calendar (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar). It then updates by itself. Each member's personal link is unchanged.

status.enabled: The BDE link is on. Copy it and paste it into the shared calendar.

inactive.description: Turn it on to get a single link, to paste just once into the board's shared calendar.

active.title: BDE subscription link
active.description: Paste this link into the BDE's shared calendar: events then update there automatically.
active.confirmedOnly: This link only contains confirmed, non-cancelled events. Never drafts.
active.guide: Google can take several hours to refresh a subscribed calendar: that is normal.
active.limit: This link feeds a calendar, but it does not decide who can view that calendar. If you paste it into a shared calendar (for example a BDE Google Calendar), the people who have access to it, including former members, are managed in Google (or Outlook, Apple), not in this platform. Generating a new link only stops the old link from working.

regenerate.warning: The old link stops working immediately. You will need to paste the new link into the shared calendar (and remove the old subscription), otherwise the calendar will stop updating.
